about_the_game:
"Hospital Hospitality" is a 3D adventure "find and click" game. In a world engulfed in chaos and destruction, you find yourself at the center of an exciting adventure with "Hospital Hospitality."
An abandoned hospital, full of secrets and horrors, becomes the arena for your heroism. Here, survival is not enough — you must save the life of your friend who is in critical condition.
How do you summon the strength and resourcefulness at this moment?

Explore the grim corridors and abandoned wards. Every movement brings a new discovery: a mysterious note, a forgotten medication.
The sense of unease grows with every door you open!

Game Features:

Exploration
Atmospheric sound and graphics
Engaging location

"Hospital Hospitality" is not just a game; it’s a true test for you.
Will you be able to explore these sinister spaces, gather the necessary supplies, and save your friend? Every move could be crucial.
